interactionBoundary: Static mechanism; only beam, medium and detector opacity/flow should be animated by the chapter's shared transmission model. No moving material geometry.
scienceBoundary: Two independent calibrated incoherent input beams. Weights f and 1-f, optical depths tau and 0.1, independent detector signals f*exp(-tau) and (1-f)*exp(-0.1). External numerical sum, no optical recombination. Color identifies channels, not wavelength. Decorative flow is not a photon Monte Carlo simulation or light-speed display.
